name: Bean
title: The Beanstalk Farm Shadow
tagline: Born in London's era, Bean haunts the wound left by BeanstalkFarms.

chapters.heading: The birth of bean
paragraphs: A single candle flickers over the memory of August 6, 2021. A wallet deployed Bean on August 6, 2021. It was born as a small program that lives on Ethereum.
The world was in the London era when it arrived. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It was crafted using Solidity 0.7.6.
Bean is now about 5 years old. It sits in the shadows of the past, a ghost of the code that remains.

chapters.heading: The pulse of the bean
paragraphs: The candle flickers over 5093 transactions. People reached out with approve and transfer. It stayed busy every year since 2025.
The records point to BeanstalkFarms on 2022-04-16. It sits in the DeFiHackLabs repository. The ghost speaks of a DAO and a Flashloan.

chapters.heading: The heavy shadow of the farm
paragraphs: I am a token. My address is named in the DeFiHackLabs record of the BeanstalkFarms incident. The record does not say what part I played. The loss belongs to BeanstalkFarms as a whole, not to me alone.
The wound is high and true. It happened on April 16, 2022. A DAO and a Flashloan tore through the code. $182 million vanished in the night.

chapters.heading: The lingering shadow of bean
paragraphs: The ghost of BeanstalkFarms haunts the spirit. It is a governance flaw deep in the marrow. No compiler version and no Solidity upgrade can heal this wound.

Count the voting power from a snapshot taken before a proposal opens. This stops borrowed tokens from voting. Put a delay between a passing vote and its execution. This prevents a one-transaction loan from passing and running a proposal.

buster.fix_reason: No compiler version fixes this wound: it is a governance flaw (cause in the record: 'DAO + Flashloan'). The buster's advice is a general mitigation for that kind of flaw, written by hand, not taken from the incident's references.

mitigation.advice: Count voting power from a snapshot taken before a proposal opens, so borrowed tokens cannot vote. Put a delay between a vote passing and its execution, so a one-transaction loan cannot pass and run a proposal.
